description: This file contains unit tests for timer functionalities and watchdog mechanisms within the WPEFramework, utilizing Google Test framework. It defines classes for handling timers and watchdogs, and includes multiple test cases for timer scheduling, past time handling, and watchdog behavior.

classes.name: TimeHandler
classes.description: A class that handles timing events, including scheduling and counting timer invocations.

classes.name: WatchDogHandler
classes.description: A class that manages a watchdog timer, capable of starting, expiring, and waiting.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Returns the scheduled time in ticks or zero if already done.

methods.name: GetCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times the timer has been triggered.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the watchdog timer with a specified delay.

methods.name: Expired
methods.description: Handles the expiration event of the watchdog.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the watchdog to expire or timeout.
